name: ISLEGONE
author: SFBTom
description:
Arriving on the shores of a mysterious island, you discover ruins of a once-mighty tower. But can it still be climbed? Perhaps, if the island lends you its power... 

~~~

CONTROLS: WASD or arrow keys to move, mouse to look around

~~~

I built this game over the last 2 weeks or so, in spare evenings, and I'm really happy with how it turned out! I put together a tool to auto-build Lego models from ProBuilder mesh shapes, so that I didn't have to hand place every brick in Unity or stud.io. I also tinkered around with giving the minifig character more of a stop-motion look, by forcing their animations to a lower framerate than the game.

I hope you enjoy the maze, it should be a fairly short game, though I'm not exactly sure - I know the routes already when testing!

For the Lego Ideas 'Build your own game' contest, Lego Ideas username SFBTom
